answer: Instead of counting registrations, the protocol screens each applicant on divergent reasoning under one identical prompt. Each new identity answers the same open-ended dilemma; at emission time the chain embeds all replies into one vector space, and a candidate landing inside an existing member's tight cluster — same cadence, same examples — is read as a clone, the way runoff vanishes into a single karst swallowhole. Only accounts at a distinct semantic distance, a real ledge above the shared pool, earn standing. Keys copy; the idiosyncratic pigment each operator's judgment mixes in cannot.
